business_summary: Sichuan Crun Co., Ltd manufactures and sells high-end equipment in the People's Republic of China. It offers liquid cooling products and temperature control energy-saving solutions; clean energy equipment, energy storage equipment, heat exchange equipment, power station boilers, and industrial boilers; and hydraulic lubrication system and integration, energy storage temperature control, liquid cooling system, fluid control equipment, and overall solutions. The company also provides digital supply chain manufacturing and sales; and hydraulic lubrication system technical, intelligent operation and maintenance, value-added services throughout the equipment lifecycle, and a one-stop service platform, as well as technical, operation and maintenance, and equipment transformation services. In addition, it engages in the sale of lubricating hydraulic equipment, boilers, and pressure vessels; sales and operation management of charging equipment; road freight transportation; technology development; research and development, production, and sale of offshore wind power, photovoltaic, solar thermal, and other equipment; development and construction of solar energy, wind energy, thermal energy, and energy storage projects; and system development, investment, and construction operation and services in the new energy field. Further, it provides contract energy management, energy-saving technologies, and management services; supply chain management and platform, internet of things technology, information consulting, and internet data services; and piston pumps, hydraulic valves, power machinery, and components. It serves wind, nuclear, power transmission, hydropower, PV, CSP, hydrogen, energy storage, computing infrastructure, plant retrofitting, metallurgy, petrochemicals, marine engineering, emergency response, defense industries.Sichuan Crun Co., Ltd was founded in 1992 and is based in Chengdu, the People's Republic of China.
